title: Finite pushforward algebra gives quasi-coherent derived Hom
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then the sheaf algebra $B=f_*\mathcal O_X$ is pseudo-coherent as an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and the derived internal Hom $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], viewed via its natural $B$-module structure [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module] as an object of $D(B)$, belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(B)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]; after forgetting the $B$-module structure its image in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y).

source.place: Tag 0AX2, lemma-finite-twisted (using Tags 0AUC and 0AUP for finite pseudo-coherence and quasi-coherence of internal Hom)

proof.text: Because $f$ is finite and $Y$ is Noetherian, $B=f_*\mathcal O_X$ is coherent quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-coherent]. By [lem-sc-coherent-pseudo-coherent] and [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], $B$ is pseudo-coherent.

Apply [lem-sc-pseudo-coherent-rhom-qcoherent] to the quasi-coherent algebra $B$ and $K$. By [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module] its derived internal Hom has the natural $B$-module structure, and the lemma gives $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(B)$ membership as defined in [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra].

By [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra], a quasi-coherent $B$-module has quasi-coherent underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Restriction of scalars leaves cohomology unchanged, so the object belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.
